details.parties_quote:
This Agreement is made as of ____________, 2026 between:

**Coastal Mutual Insurance Company**, a Florida corporation having its principal office at 800 Brickell Avenue, Miami, Florida 33131 ("**Client**"); and

payment_source.quote: Client shall pay each invoice within sixty (60) days of the invoice date.

details.services_summary: Design and build a claims analytics platform for Client in three milestones.

liability_cap.basis: Vendor's liability under this Agreement is unlimited.
liability_cap.quote: Vendor's liability under this Agreement is unlimited. Client's liability is limited to the fees payable under this Agreement.

delay_penalty.quote: If Vendor fails to complete any milestone by its due date, Vendor shall pay Client liquidated damages of two percent (2%) of the total project fee for each week of delay until completion.

titles: Delay penalty with no exclusion for client-caused delay
Termination for convenience without work-in-progress payment

all_findings.title: Liability is unlimited
all_findings.comparison: Past contracts: 8 of 10 cap liability at about 1x fees; highest seen 2x.
all_findings.quote: Vendor's liability under this Agreement is unlimited. Client's liability is limited to the fees payable under this Agreement.

all_findings.title: Delay penalty with no exclusion for client-caused delay
all_findings.why: AtliQ could pay for delays it did not cause (Brightwater).
all_findings.comparison: Past contracts cap penalties at 5% of the milestone and exclude client delay (3 of 3).
all_findings.quote: If Vendor fails to complete any milestone by its due date, Vendor shall pay Client liquidated damages of two percent (2%) of the total project fee for each week of delay until completion.

all_findings.title: Client acquires AtliQ pre-existing tools
all_findings.why: AtliQ loses ownership of its reusable pre-existing background tools.
all_findings.comparison: Northwind is the only past exception; standard is AtliQ keeps tools.
all_findings.quote: All work product, including Vendor's pre-existing tools incorporated in it, is owned by Client on creation.

all_findings.title: One-sided indemnity covers client negligence
all_findings.why: Makes AtliQ cover damages caused by the client's own fault.
all_findings.comparison: Principles require mutual indemnity and exclude covering client negligence.
all_findings.quote: Vendor shall indemnify, defend and hold harmless Client from all claims, losses and costs arising from the Services or this Agreement, including claims arising from Client's own negligence.

all_findings.title: Termination for convenience without work-in-progress payment
all_findings.why: AtliQ performs uncompensated work if terminated for convenience.
all_findings.comparison: Principles state AtliQ must be paid for work done on termination.
all_findings.quote: Client may terminate at any time for convenience without payment for work in progress.

all_findings.title: Payment in 60 days
all_findings.why: Long payment terms hurt cash flow.
all_findings.quote: Client shall pay each invoice within sixty (60) days of the invoice date.

all_findings.title: Restrictive termination right for AtliQ
all_findings.why: Denies AtliQ standard exit rights for other material client breaches.
all_findings.comparison: Unusual restriction compared to standard commercial agreements.
all_findings.quote: Vendor may terminate only for Client's non-payment continuing for ninety (90) days.
